purpose: Teach: 一世/一丸/私用/線引き/お披露目/品位/要人/手先

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文で、本気で、絶対、学界に、絶対、一世、絶対、を、絶対、風靡しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren, make sure this paper makes a real impact in the academic world. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Steady, direct. Measured tempo. Weight behind each clause. Not harsh—the tone of someone who trusts and expects that trust to be earned. Brief pause before the final sentence, settling it in.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室、本気で、絶対、一丸、絶対、と、絶対、なって、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The whole lab is pulling together on this, and I'm grateful for the opportunity.
lines.style: Respectful but not stiff. Quiet focus. Careful enunciation on key words, but natural rhythm underneath. The tone of someone taking responsibility seriously without performing anxiety.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究室の、本気で、絶対、機器、絶対、私用、絶対、せず、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And make sure the lab equipment is used only for its intended purpose. No exceptions.
lines.style: Firm and clear. Slight emphasis on the boundary being drawn. Professional tone, but warm underneath—the warmth of someone protecting something they've built. No room for misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究テーマの、本気で、絶対、線引き、絶対、明確に、絶対、いたしました、本気for、感謝
lines.en: Understood. I've already made it clear where the research boundaries are. Thank you for the trust.
lines.style: Calm, assured. Demonstrates he's already ahead of the instruction. Not defensive—confident without arrogance. Delivers the gratitude as genuine, not rote.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新理論の、本気で、絶対、お披露目、絶対、学会で、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When you present the new theory at the conference, do it thoroughly. Make it count.
lines.style: Measured intensity. Each word carries weight without rushing. A pause before 'Make it count'—settling the real expectation. The voice of someone who knows what's at stake.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の、本気で、絶対、品位、絶対、保ってまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure the paper maintains the highest standard. Thank you for believing in us.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not rushing the words. Slight lift on 'highest standard' but grounded. The gratitude is genuine—he means it. Closes with steady composure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 招聘した、本気で、絶対、要人、絶対、研究員、絶対、丁重に、絶対、対応しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And treat the visiting researchers with the utmost respect. They're here because of what you've accomplished.
lines.style: Slightly warmer than the other directions. Pride underlying the instruction. Measured pace. A brief pause before the final clause—giving weight to the reminder of earned trust.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究の、本気で、絶対、手先、絶対、として、絶対、私、絶対、貢献してまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'll represent the lab and our research with integrity every single day. Thank you.
lines.style: Steady and grounded. Small emphasis on 'integrity' and 'every single day'—shows he understands the weight. Closes firmly but warmly. The tone of someone who has heard the call and will answer it.
